title: Vernestra Rwoh
description: Vernestra Rwoh was a teenage prodigy. She was one of the youngest Jedi ever to be made a Knight in a generation, and she took a Padawan only a year later. Her purple-bladed Lightsaber could transform into a lightwhip. A hundred years after the fall of the Starlight Beacon, she served as a liaison between the Senate and the Jedi, and the handling of the investigation into Master Indara's murder fell to her.
